Ordinary Python source on the frozen head; no Markdown-fence obstruction.
CausalEnvironment implements rule shifts at t=50 and t=150 among R0_extinguish, R1_explosion and R2_requires_water with action-dependent success/failure/neutral outcomes.
GenericAgent maintains M,P,V and hypothesis entropy; modes A/C disallow V updates while B/D/E allow them.
Prediction depends on M>0.5 and action depends on P>0.5.
On delta_E!=0, candidate M/P/V updates have fixed magnitudes and costs; V's effective error depends on V-dV and cost_V depends on lambda_V and I_iso.
Mode E chooses M/P/V randomly; A/C minimize among non-V candidates; B/D minimize source-defined total loss over all candidates, with D using cost_M=0.1.
run_single_seed calls random.seed(seed); within the frozen implementation, random.choice in mode E is the only explicit random draw.
MetricsTracker implements K_E interval, I_iso and H_F; run loop derives world/self update fractions and C_rev=solved/t.
run_single_seed defaults to total_steps=200 and iterates modes A,B,C,D,E separately with fresh environment/agent/tracker state.
Each logged timestep includes t, mode, constraints, prediction, actual_outcome, delta_E, candidates, mutation_selected, dM/dP/dV, norms, world/self fractions, M/P/V state, K_E, I_iso, H_F and C_rev.
Runner serializes results to results/raw_seed_<seed>.json with indent=2 and prints an execution/save message.
Serialized results dictionary contains mode logs but the frozen output schema does not include a seed/run-id field inside the JSON payload; seed is encoded in the output filename by the runner.
